dishes.name: Denizli kebabı
dishes.desc: Lamb cooked in a tandır oven, eaten with onion, tomato and lavaş. It received a geographical indication in 2010.

dishes.name: Tavas güveci
dishes.desc: A güveç from the Tavas district cooked for hours without spices. A local favorite beyond the town.

dishes.name: Yen böreği
dishes.desc: A main-course pastry with minced meat filling in a cornmeal dough, made in villages for special days and guests. Also written leyen böreği.

dishes.name: Tavas baklavası
dishes.desc: Baklava from the Tavas district, one of the local products Denizli promotes on its gastronomy routes.

dishes.name: Börülce böreği
dishes.desc: A pastry of crumbled dry yufka and boiled black-eyed peas, often served with pickles. A Denizli country dish.
